verdict.rationale: Zep supports some bulk-like operations — deleting a User cascades to delete all associated Threads and artifacts in one API call (zep-docs-5, zep-docs-35), and node deletion cascades to connected edges (zep-docs-13, zep-docs-21) — plus zepctl CLI offers terminal-based management of users/threads/graphs that could enable scripted bulk actions (zep-docs-7, zep-docs-23). However there's no documented batch/bulk ingest, batch search, or explicit multi-item API endpoints. Missing for 10: explicit bulk create/update/ingest APIs, batch query operations, and evidence of large-scale bulk workflows beyond cascade-deletes and CLI scripting.
